print"Aspect env dtc test >_ made by za1k dm me with ur result to get on leaderboard"
local zalk,zalk_names={},{}
local function addCheck(nameOrFunc,maybeFunc)
 if type(nameOrFunc)=="function"then
 table.insert(zalk,nameOrFunc)
 table.insert(zalk_names,"check#"..tostring(#zalk))
 else
 table.insert(zalk,maybeFunc)
 table.insert(zalk_names,tostring(nameOrFunc))
 end
end
addCheck("ReflectionService",function()return game:GetService'ReflectionService'end)
addCheck("Vector3 math",function()local v,v2=Vector3.new(1,2,3),Vector3.new(4,5,6)
local dot=v:Dot(v2)
if dot~=32 then return false end
local cross=v:Cross(v2)
if cross.X~=-3 or cross.Y~=6 or cross.Z~=-3 then return false end
local sum=v+v2
if sum.X~=5 or sum.Y~=7 or sum.Z~=9 then return false end
local mag=v.Magnitude
if math.abs(mag-math.sqrt(14))>0.001 then return false end
return true
 end)
addCheck("Color3",function()local c,c2=Color3.new(0.5,0.6,0.7),Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0)
if c2.R~=1 or c2.G~=0 or c2.B~=0 then return false end
if c.R~=0.5 then return false end
return true
 end)
addCheck("CFrame",function()local cf=CFrame.new(1,2,3)
if cf.Position.X~=1 or cf.Position.Y~=2 or cf.Position.Z~=3 then return false end
local inv=cf:Inverse()
if not inv then return false end
return true
 end)
addCheck("UDim2",function()local u2=UDim2.new(0.5,10,0.3,5)
if u2.X.Scale~=0.5 or u2.X.Offset~=10 then return false end
return true
 end)
addCheck("Vector3 math",function()local ray=Ray.new(Vector3.new(0,0,0),Vector3.new(1,0,0))
if ray.Origin.X~=0 then return false end
return true
 end)
addCheck("Instance.Part",function()local p=Instance.new'Part'
p.Name='Test'
if p.Name~='Test'then return false end
local child=Instance.new'Part'
child.Name='Child'
child.Parent=p
if p:FindFirstChild'Child'~=child then return false end
local clone=p:Clone()
if clone.Name~='Test'then return false end
clone:Destroy()
p:Destroy()
return true
 end)
addCheck("Instance.Part",function()local p=Instance.new'Part'
local signal=p:GetPropertyChangedSignal'Position'
if not signal or not signal.IsA or not signal:IsA'RBXScriptSignal'then p:Destroy()return false end
p:Destroy()
return true
 end)
addCheck("Instance.Accessory",function()local inst=Instance.new'Accessory'
if not inst then return false end
if inst.ClassName~='Accessory'then return false end
local props=ReflectionService:GetPropertiesOfClass('Accessory',{Security=SecurityCapabilities.fromCurrent()})
for _,prop in ipairs(props)do
 local val=inst[prop.Name]
 local ok,err=pcall(function()inst[prop.Name]=val end)
 if not ok then
 end
 break
end
local methods=ReflectionService:GetMethodsOfClass('Accessory',{Security=SecurityCapabilities.fromCurrent()})
for _,method in ipairs(methods)do
 if method.Name~='Destroy'and method.Name~='Clone'and method.Name~='GetChildren'then
 local ok,err=pcall(function()inst[method.Name](inst)end)
 end
 break
end
inst:Destroy()
return true
 end)

local classSuper={}
for _,line in ipairs(splitLines(CLASS_ROWS))do
 local name,super=string.match(line,'^([^|]+)|([^|]+)$')
 if name then classSuper[name]=super end
end
local runtimeClassSet,runtimeClassBuilt=nil,false
local function securityFilter()
 local ok,caps=pcall(function()return SecurityCapabilities.fromCurrent()end)
 if ok and caps~=nil then return{Security=caps}end
 return{}
end
local function getRuntimeClasses()
 if runtimeClassBuilt then return runtimeClassSet end
 runtimeClassBuilt=true
 runtimeClassSet={}
 if RS then
 local attempts={function()return RS:GetClasses({})end,function()return RS:GetClasses(securityFilter())end,}
 for _,attempt in ipairs(attempts)do
 local ok,list=pcall(attempt)
 if ok and type(list)=='table'and#list>0 then
 for _,entry in ipairs(list)do
 local n=entry
 if type(entry)=='table'then n=entry.Name or entry.name end
 if type(n)=='string'then runtimeClassSet[n]=true end
 end
 if next(runtimeClassSet)~=nil then break end
 end
 end
 end
 return runtimeClassSet
end
local function reflectList(meth,className)
 if not RS then return nil end
 local ok,list=pcall(function()return RS[meth](RS,className,{})end)
 if ok and type(list)=='table'and#list>0 then return list end
 local ok2,list2=pcall(function()return RS[meth](RS,className,securityFilter())end)
 if ok2 and type(list2)=='table'then return list2 end
 if ok and type(list)=='table'then return list end
 return nil
end
local memberCache,memberReflector={},{Property='GetPropertiesOfClass',Function='GetMethodsOfClass',Event='GetEventsOfClass'}
local function getMemberSet(className)
 local hit=memberCache[className]
 if hit then return hit end
 local set={Property={},Function={},Event={}}
 for kind,meth in pairs(memberReflector)do
 local list=reflectList(meth,className)
 if type(list)=='table'then
 for _,m in ipairs(list)do
 local n=m
 if type(m)=='table'then n=m.Name or m.name end
 if type(n)=='string'then set[kind][n]=true end
 end
 end
 end
 memberCache[className]=set
 return set
end
local function hasMember(className,kind,member)
 local cur,guard=className,0
 while cur and guard<64 do
 local set=getMemberSet(cur)
 if set[kind]and set[kind][member]then return true end
 cur=classSuper[cur]
 guard=guard+1
 end
 return false
end
local classFallback={}
local function classRegistered(name)
 if getRuntimeClasses()[name]==true then return true end
 local cached=classFallback[name]
 if cached~=nil then return cached end
 local found,okNew=false,pcall(function()local inst=Instance.new(name)if inst then inst:Destroy()end return true end)
 if okNew then found=true end
 if not found and RS then
 local ok,info=pcall(RS.GetClass,RS,name,securityFilter())
 if ok and type(info)=='table'then found=true end
 end
 if not found then
 local ok,inst=pcall(function()return game:FindService(name)end)
 if ok and inst~=nil then found=true end
 end
 classFallback[name]=found
 return found
end
local function classReflects(name)
 if RS then
 local ok,info=pcall(RS.GetClass,RS,name,{})
 if ok and type(info)=='table'then return true end
 local ok2,info2=pcall(RS.GetClass,RS,name,securityFilter())
 if ok2 and type(info2)=='table'then return true end
 end
 return classRegistered(name)
end
local function enumType(name)
 local ok,e=pcall(function()return Enum[name]end)
 if not ok then return nil end
 return e
end
local function enumItem(t,i)
 local e=enumType(t)
 if not e then return nil end
 local ok,it=pcall(function()return e[i]end)
 if not ok then return nil end
 return it
end
local propMap,methodMap,eventMap={},{},{}
local function buildMap(cls,kind,cache)
 local hit=cache[cls]
 if hit then return hit end
 local map,meth={},kind=='Property'and'GetPropertiesOfClass'or(kind=='Function'and'GetMethodsOfClass'or'GetEventsOfClass')
 local list=reflectList(meth,cls)
 if type(list)=='table'then
 for _,d in ipairs(list)do
 if type(d)=='table'then local n=d.Name or d.name if type(n)=='string'then map[n]=d end end
 end
 end
 cache[cls]=map
 return map
end
local function classData(cls)
 if not RS then return nil end
 local ok,info=pcall(RS.GetClass,RS,cls,securityFilter())
 if ok and type(info)=='table'then return info end
 local ok2,info2=pcall(RS.GetClass,RS,cls,{})
 if ok2 and type(info2)=='table'then return info2 end
 return nil
end
local PRIM,VALUE_ALIAS={bool='boolean',int='number',int64='number',float='number',double='number',string='string',Enum='EnumItem',Instance='Instance'},{int64='int',int='int64'}
local function typeOk(expected,v)
 local want=PRIM[expected]or expected
 return typeof(v)==want
end
local function memberOk(cls,kind,member)
 if not classRegistered(cls)then return true end
 return hasMember(cls,kind,member)
end
local function serviceOk(name)
 local ok,inst=pcall(function()return game:FindService(name)end)
 if not ok then return false end
 if inst~=nil and inst.ClassName~=name then return false end
 return true
end

local passed,failed,failures=0,0,{}
for i,func in ipairs(zalk)do
 local ok,result=pcall(func)
 if ok and result then
 passed=passed+1
 else
 failed=failed+1
 local name=zalk_names[i]or("check#"..tostring(i))
 local reason
 if not ok then
 reason="error: "..tostring(result)
 else
 reason="returned false"
 end
 table.insert(failures,{index=i,name=name,reason=reason})
 end
end
local total,percent=passed+failed,0
if total>0 then
 percent=(passed/total)*100
end
print('pass to fail ratio bleh: '..string.format('%.2f%%',percent))
print('failed dis many --> '..tostring(failed))
print('passed dis many --> '..tostring(passed))
print('total checks --> '..tostring(total))
print'========== FAILED CHECKS =========='
if#failures==0 then
 print'(none)'
else
 for _,f in ipairs(failures)do
 print(string.format('[%d] %s  |  %s',f.index,f.name,f.reason))
 end
end
print'========== END FAILED CHECKS =========='
print('failed_count='..tostring(failed))
local rating=''
if percent<10 then rating='wrap it up g'
elseif percent<20 then rating='bro ts buns'
elseif percent<30 then rating='yo shi is shitty g'
elseif percent<40 then rating='eh mid wouldnt recommend using this env'
elseif percent<50 then rating='eh theres better envs like https://aspectt.lol'
elseif percent<60 then rating='not bad but still not good..'
elseif percent<70 then rating='oo not bad still under 70%'
elseif percent<80 then rating='pretty okay!'
elseif percent<90 then rating='average environment logger! congrats'
else rating='wowie u got 100% impressive! https://aspectt.lol!'
end
print(rating)
